desc:
🌟 Welcome to Poly Loot! 🌟

Fight monsters, collect powerful loot, and become stronger as you explore new areas!

How to play?
⚔️ Defeat monsters
💎 Collect loot

scripts.title: Lumacore: Autofarm Halloween Event
scripts.features:
Keyless Mode ( Monday & Wednesday )

🎃 Ghost Farming (Auto Candy Corn)
Auto-Catch Ghosts: Finds the nearest ghost, glides to it, and catches it automatically. It pulls out your net when you turn it on and puts it away when you stop.

Two Positions (Stances):
Above Ground: Moves right inside the ghost without falling or clipping into the floor.

Underground: Hides safely under the map while catching ghosts.

Chase Mode (AI Chase): Runs after the Ghost.

Glide Speed: Choose NORMAL or SLOW to move smoothly toward ghosts without snapping too fast.

Catch Delay: Choose INSTANT to catch ghosts back-to-back, or 2.5s WAIT to take a break between ghosts so you look like a normal player.

🚶 Character
Noclip: Lets you walk right through walls, doors, and barriers.

Anti-AFK: Keeps you from getting disconnected for being idle after 20 minutes.

Clean Respawn: Instantly resets your character if you get stuck.

👁️ Visuals (ESP)
Ghost ESP: Shows how far away they are.

Player ESP: Highlights other players and shows their distance and health %.

🛒 Event Shop & Daily Claim (Just need to be close middle area!)
Daily Flame: Claims your free daily check-in flame reward with one click.

Quick Buy: Buy the Pumpkin Chest or Dungeon Pass without walking to the stall.

⚙️ Interface & Settings
Foldable Sections (Dropdowns): You can enable a setting to click any category header to fold/unfold it and keep the screen clean.

On-Screen Counters: Shows your FPS, Ping, playtime, and how many ghosts you have caught.
